items.text: Fixed ladder climbing and moving‑train boarding on the Bradley flatbed by separating ladder and parenting triggers, enlarging volumes, and adding the flatbed to the manifest.
Cows no longer slide away when hurt or dying; they now stand up correctly and play the appropriate scramble animation.
Custom monument marker names are now correctly sent to Rust+, improving monument identification on the companion app.
Bulls can now defend their herd against other animals and protect their owner's base from other players, not just from players attacking the herd.
Fixed arrow collision detection, ensuring arrows now properly hit targets.
Added a new military tunnels loot room, providing additional high‑tier loot in tunnel networks.
Animals and sea turtles now deactivate when no players are nearby, reducing unnecessary activity.
Store UI now correctly displays pack overlay images on buttons and main sections.
Factory doors now render correctly in the store after successful image loading.
Skin tiles in the store now use CoverImage, fixing display issues and removing unused components.

2026-09-10.summary:
### Transportation & Vehicles
- Fixed ladder climbing and moving‑train boarding on the Bradley flatbed by separating ladder and parenting triggers, enlarging volumes, and adding the flatbed to the manifest.

### Animal Behavior
- Cows no longer slide away when hurt or dying; they now stand up correctly and play the appropriate scramble animation.

### Rust+ Integration
- Custom monument marker names are now correctly sent to Rust+, improving monument identification on the companion app.

### NPC & AI
- Bulls can now defend their herd against other animals and protect their owner's base from other players, not just from players attacking the herd.

### Combat
- Fixed arrow collision detection, ensuring arrows now properly hit targets.

### Loot & Resources
- Added a new military tunnels loot room, providing additional high‑tier loot in tunnel networks.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Animals and sea turtles now deactivate when no players are nearby, reducing unnecessary activity.

### UI & Store
- Store UI now correctly displays pack overlay images on buttons and main sections.
- Factory doors now render correctly in the store after successful image loading.
- Skin tiles in the store now use CoverImage, fixing display issues and removing unused components.

items.text: Purchasing animals now correctly deducts scrap, and animal leads bought from vendors work as intended.
Cow selling price varies with genetics, and cows only heal when their needs are met, preventing endless healing.
New sheep traits add behavior variety, and lamb and sheep now drop raw, cooked, and spoiled Lamb Meat with updated assets.
Sea turtles introduced with proper ocean locomotion and population handling.
Stags now respond correctly to AI select and move commands.
A new ranch vendor allows players to buy and sell items directly at the ranch.
Fixed missing and misplaced crate spawns in the small easy cave map.
Added new loot rooms in Airfield and Harbor power‑grid areas, expanding high‑value loot locations.
Bullets and arrows now correctly collide with oilrig scientists' upper bodies and register headshots only when appropriate.
Heavy plate helmet and diving mask overlays remain visible when you are downed or dead, ensuring you can still see your equipment status.
Directional armour now saves and loads correctly, preventing loss of equipped armor after server restarts or reloads.
Refrigeration status updates instantly when an item is moved between containers, removing the previous delay.
Helmet audio muffling now correctly applies a low‑pass filter while you’re wounded, without being overridden by other sound snapshots.
Third‑person weapon sounds no longer play twice; glass AK uses its proper sounds and reload deploy audio is fixed.
Locomotive bell sound is now heard by nearby players, not just the client that triggered it.

2026-09-09.summary:
### Animals & Ranch
- Purchasing animals now correctly deducts scrap, and animal leads bought from vendors work as intended.
- Cow selling price varies with genetics, and cows only heal when their needs are met, preventing endless healing.
- New sheep traits add behavior variety, and lamb and sheep now drop raw, cooked, and spoiled Lamb Meat with updated assets.
- Sea turtles introduced with proper ocean locomotion and population handling.
- Stags now respond correctly to AI select and move commands.
- A new ranch vendor allows players to buy and sell items directly at the ranch.

### World & Spawning
- Fixed missing and misplaced crate spawns in the small easy cave map.
- Added new loot rooms in Airfield and Harbor power‑grid areas, expanding high‑value loot locations.

### Combat & Damage
- Bullets and arrows now correctly collide with oilrig scientists' upper bodies and register headshots only when appropriate.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Heavy plate helmet and diving mask overlays remain visible when you are downed or dead, ensuring you can still see your equipment status.
- Directional armour now saves and loads correctly, preventing loss of equipped armor after server restarts or reloads.
- Refrigeration status updates instantly when an item is moved between containers, removing the previous delay.

### Audio
- Helmet audio muffling now correctly applies a low‑pass filter while you’re wounded, without being overridden by other sound snapshots.
- Third‑person weapon sounds no longer play twice; glass AK uses its proper sounds and reload deploy audio is fixed.
- Locomotive bell sound is now heard by nearby players, not just the client that triggered it.
